name: Medexus Pharmaceuticals Inc.
summary: Medexus Pharmaceuticals Inc. is a pharmaceutical company in Canada and the United States with a focus on rare diseases, rheumatology, oncology, hematology, dermatology and allergy. Its products include IXINITY, an intravenous factor IX therapy for hemophilia B; Rasuvo and Metoject, methotrexate formulations for rheumatoid arthritis and other autoimmune diseases; Rupall, an allergy medication; and GRAFAPEX.
